title: Sulfhydryl-functionalized diarylethenes: synthesis, photoswitching, and fluorescent properties
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1443-1456
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08492J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Pramod Aryal, Jonathan Bietsch, Gowri Sankar Grandhi, Josh Choi, Guijun Wang
A series of six sulfhydryl substituted diarylethene derivatives were synthesized and characterized. The cyclopentene bridged derivatives exhibited turn-on fluorescence upon photocyclization under UV light.
